name: The Crystal River Flowing Upwards into the Stars
description: A river of shimmering, liquid crystal and light cascading upwards from a deep valley into a brilliant starry night sky, with glowing light fish swimming in it.
prompt: A surreal landscape where a river of liquid crystal and glowing light flows upwards, defying gravity, cascading into a brilliant starry sky. The river is filled with luminous, glowing fish and sparkling particles. The valley below is dark and silhouetted, contrasting with the vibrant, shimmering blue and silver light of the upward river. Epic, cosmic, fantasy art style.
caption: Where gravity is just a suggestion, and the river flows towards the infinite stars. 🌌💧
